tasks.name: Netcode Architecture
tasks.objective: Produce the Netcode Architecture for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Authority model stated per system (server, client, hybrid)
Tick rate, snapshot rate and bandwidth budget in numbers
Trust boundary drawn and every client-supplied value validated server-side

tasks.name: Replication and Session Layer
tasks.objective: Produce the Replication and Session Layer for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Players join, play and leave a session without desync
Bandwidth measured in a full session against the budget

tasks.name: Network Validation
tasks.objective: Produce the Network Validation for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Two-client test evidence attached including unauthorised actions rejected
Simulated latency and packet loss behaviour documented
No client-authoritative value can grant an unfair advantage
